source.document: Xefo Rapid 8 mg film-coated tablets SmPC (PA1547/005/004)

key_sections_summary: 8–16 mg/d (max 16); renal/hepatic impairment: once daily; CI severe RI (SCr >700 µmol/L); caution SCr 150–700; PB 99%; CYP2C9; t1/2 3–4 h; PK unchanged in renal failure.
